children: Australian shares were set to eke out marginal gains at open on Wednesday, propelled by potential gains in mining and energy stocks on higher commodity prices, while weaker bullion was expected to weigh on the gold sub-index.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) rose 0.2%, a 3.2-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark fell 1% on Tuesday.
